
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /help  (/h, /?)                            │
  │  Help Menu                                  │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Show the help menu or detailed help for a specific command.

  Usage:
    /help
    /help <command>

  Details:
    Displays the main help menu with categorized commands.
    Pass a command name to get detailed help, usage examples, and tips.

  Examples:
    $ /help
    $ /help skill
    $ /help plan
    $ /h complexity

  Tips:
    Tip: You can also ask naturally, e.g. 'how do I use skills?'

  Related: /tools  /modes
